# Registered Nurse, Intensive Care Unit

Employer: Fjordhavn Regional Hospital, Aarhus (day, evening and night shifts)

Fjordhavn Regional Hospital is a fictional hospital. We care about patient safety, respect and teamwork on every shift.

## About the role
You will provide bedside care for critically ill adult patients in a 14-bed intensive care unit, work with physicians and physiotherapists, and support families.

## What you bring
- A bachelor's degree in nursing and an active nursing licence
- At least 2 years of clinical experience in intensive care, anaesthesia or emergency nursing
- Experience operating ventilators, arterial lines and infusion pumps
- Basic and advanced life support certification (BLS/ACLS)
- Ability to work rotating shifts, including nights and weekends

## Nice to have
- A critical care nursing specialisation
- Experience supervising nursing students

## Practical
Relocation is not offered; candidates should live within commuting distance of Aarhus. Apply by 15 December.
